designationHistory.indexText: Supawna Meadows National Wildlife Refuge About Us Contact Us Visit Us Activities Trails Rules & Policies Get Involved Events News Species Map About Us Established in 1974, Supawna Meadows National Wildlife Refuge is located in Pennsville, NJ (Salem County) along the Delaware River estuary just north of the Salem River.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
